description:
FREE quick check of a French company by SIREN (10 calls per day): official name, active/closed status, head-office city, and the NUMBER of alerts found (insolvency proceedings, closure, closed head office…), without their detail.

Use it first to triage. If alertes > 0, or before paying or onboarding a supplier, call verifier_entreprise ($0.01 via x402) for the verdict, the sourced signals with links to the official notices, the insolvency history (BODACC) and the VAT number checked in VIES.

For sole traders, only the trade name is returned, never the person's name.

siren.description: SIREN (9 digits, Luhn-valid) or 14-digit SIRET. Spaces, dots and dashes are accepted.

title: Aperçu gratuit d'une entreprise française (SIREN)
